plain: How much something can hold or make; also the ability to do something

webster.text: Passive power; the power of containing, or holding; extent of room or space; as the capacity of a vessel, or a cask.

example.quote: Experience had shewn in a variety of instances that both a capacity & inclination for public service existed-in very advanced stages.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, July 24, 1787
